instruction: Fix `LRUCache.put` so it evicts the least-recently-used key (the current code pops the most-recently-used key instead).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/ds.py b/ds.py
--- a/ds.py
+++ b/ds.py
@@ -105,7 +105,7 @@
         self._items[key] = value
         self._order.append(key)
         if len(self._items) > self.capacity:
-            evict = self._order.pop()
+            evict = self._order.pop(0)
             del self._items[evict]
